description: Monthly counts of what AI agents can do at the websites this network checked: how many an agent can message, book, order from or pay, through which doors, by country, kind of business (group), website platform, where the sites came from (source) or city. Counts only; no business is named. Without edition, the latest published one; without scope, the whole; with a scope and no key, each key's headline counts; with a key, all of its counts. Open data under CC BY 4.0: credit "Surfing Dog census, surfingdog.ai, CC BY 4.0", and "© Overture Maps Foundation" with city counts. Capability ids are defined at https://surfingdog.ai/spec/capabilities/.

edition.description: The month, YYYY-MM. Without it, the latest published edition.

key.description: One key of the scope: a country code (GB), a group slug, a platform slug, a source, or a city slug (madrid). Without it, every key of the scope with its headline counts.

scope.description: all (the default), country, group (kind of business), platform, source (where the sites came from) or city.
